h: 正在寻找一个简单的工作流程来开始在 ComfyUI 中使用 Z-Image Turbo？它有一个可选的高档通行证组，并且基于一体化检查点风格模型。我已将所需的节点包降至最低。

o.en: Looking for a simple workflow to get started with Z-Image Turbo in ComfyUI? This has an optional upscale pass group, and is based on an all in one Checkpoint style model. I've kept the required node pack down to a minimum.
